answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150657 Country: India Title: My name is Numaan. Can you please tell the right meaning of my name. Question: My name is Numaan. Can you please tell the right meaning of my name. Answer ID: 150657 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 693/551/D=8/1438) Noman is good name. It was the name of a Sahabi. It is also the name of famous Imam Abu Hanifah (may Allah have mercy upon him). This is enough for the virtue and blessing of this name that it had been the names of such great personalities. According Misbahul Lughat, it means: Gul-e-Lala (tulip). It is also written that it had been the surname of each rulers of al-Hirah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
